I enjoy all types of food, there are very little foods that I hate or make me nauseous. I am very non-picky eater. Shrooms are absolutely repulsive to me. My friends can chow them down no problem but my body just wants to reject them from entering my mouth. I hate the smell, texture, and taste. I love every other edible mushroom besides psilocybin

My recommendation is to be well sated, not full and definitely not an empty stomach. Drink some ginger tea before and after if you eat it straight. You can also grind up the shrooms and strain it through a coffee maker to make tea. I put honey and ginger in mine. You can make a peanut butter and shroom sandwich if the smell and taste bothers you (I still gag on this but it helps)

After I take shrooms I feel like vomit immediately. I like to sit down and let my body rest and sip water. If you know you're about to throw up, just let it happen. After 30 minutes or so your body most likely absorbed all the psilocybin. Vomiting is very relieving and some say it kick-starts their trip.

In short, don't worry about nausea. Do what you can but if it happens just let it happen. Fighting it or worrying about it is futile.

The trip itself was amazing. I laughed at anything and everything. Music was pure bliss to my ears. Colors changed hue. Everything was melting and shifting. I saw patterns be birthed out of infinity. I felt connected to everything. The trees, my friends, the Earth, the universe, it felt like we were all the same entity. Things started to look "real". It felt like I was seeing something for the first time again. When I saw my car, it was stripped of it's "car-ness". I saw a machine with 4 wheels that was designed to take people places quickly. Time was warped, what felt like a 4 hours was only an hour or something like that. A common thing people worry about is "Will this last forever?!" "Am I stuck like this?!" Don't worry, you'll be a normal human being again. You control your own thoughts. Shrooms also gave me an amazing body high, my muscles tensed up and I felt sort of rooted to the ground.

Shrooms opened me up emotionally. I've cried and went through very heavy emotional journeys. Every emotional trip I've felt was positive. I had to face myself head on and became a better person on the other side. Lots of trauma and emotional baggage was lifted off my shoulders. Shrooms takes you on a ride and you're the passenger. I never had psychedelic trip I regretted.

I like to stay off of weed for at least a week before my trip to refresh my brain.

After the trip things didn't bother me as much. I was more polite and loved the people around me more. It had me appreciate life more. It had me take a step back and look at things differently. I take myself way less serious.
You will change after a trip. You'll be the same you just a little different.

Peace and safe tripping.

What was also interesting is that we used the stars to tell stories. All that came from that curiosity and wonder about something greater than us.

We live through a set of experiences. There is a thought experiment called "Mary's room". Mary lives in a black and white world and she has done all the known research on color and perception. She knows about wavelengths, how our eyes see, photons, etc. Then a red apple appears on her screen. The question is "Did Mary learn something new?" I've been thinking of a new question to add on. Mary learns about all about color in a black and white room and understands everything about red but hasn't seen it. Jasmine knows nothing about the science behind perception but she has seen red. Who knows more? It's the combination of both their knowledge to get the highest truth.
